hypothesis: B-cell-active phenotype may enrich depletion/reset benefit
candidate_rule: Prespecified reproducible assay panel plus active disease; no invented composite threshold
clinical_test: Prospective treatment-by-biomarker interaction; clinical effect beyond pharmacodynamics
commercial_interpretation: Possible development wedge; fraction not estimated
disconfirming_result: No interaction or no meaningful benefit despite marker/depletion change
caveat: Prognostic/diagnostic association is not predictive validation

hypothesis: Glandular reserve may matter for measurable recovery
candidate_rule: Objective residual function and imaging/history; protocol threshold required
clinical_test: Function plus patient benefit stratified by baseline reserve
commercial_interpretation: Potential treatable subset; no early-disease market size
disconfirming_result: No reserve-response association or function change without meaningful benefit
caveat: Short duration does not prove reversible gland injury

hypothesis: Refractory active systemic disease may be a feasible reset study wedge
candidate_rule: Documented current activity and treatment failures plus actual safety eligibility
clinical_test: Organ/systemic benefit; drug-free durability and reconstitution under JHA-142
commercial_interpretation: Need must be tested against centre capacity and safety exclusions
disconfirming_result: Ineligible proportion or risk/benefit defeats wedge
caveat: High need is not proof of modality fit

hypothesis: Symptom endotypes may inform stratified trial design
candidate_rule: Use published classifier including all required inputs; do not map from ESSPRI alone
clinical_test: Prospectively validate subgroup interaction in target population and modality
commercial_interpretation: Research stratification; no US share inferred from European cohorts
disconfirming_result: No reproducible classifier or treatment interaction in prospective validation
caveat: Existing reanalyses do not establish prospective reset-response selection
